The *Saraṇagamaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 361) is a verse biographical text belonging to the *Therāpadāna* collection of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. It recounts the past karmic deeds and present attainment of the elder Saraṇagamaniya. On SuttaCentral, five modern translations into five different languages are listed for this text [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit corpora are reported by SuttaCentral or recorded in DharmaNexus algorithms [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus identifies Pali-internal verse reuse with two other Therāpadāna texts: it shares segments §2.1–5.1 with the *Tisaraṇagamaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 25, §27.1–30.1) and segments §0.2–2.4 with a homonymous poem, the *Saraṇagamaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 525, §0.2–2.4) [DharmaNexus].
